```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
import markdown
from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD CMS CONTENT
# ----------------------------------------------------------

with open("../../content/whalewatch_explorer.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)

def md(value):
    return markdown.markdown(
        str(value or ""),
        extensions=["tables", "sane_lists"]
    )

hero = data.get("hero", {})
instructions = data.get("instructions", {})
explorer = data.get("explorer", {})
disclaimer = data.get("disclaimer", {})

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# INSTRUCTIONS LIST
# ----------------------------------------------------------

instruction_list = "".join(
    f"<li>{safe(step)}</li>"
    for step in instructions.get("steps", [])
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# PAGE HTML
# ----------------------------------------------------------

html = f"""
<div class="cw-whale cw-whale-explorer">

  <!-- PROJECT NAVIGATION -->
  <div class="cw-whale-topbar">

    <nav class="cw-whale-tabs" aria-label="WhaleWatch navigation">

      <a class="cw-whale-tab" href="whalewatch.html">
        WhaleWatch 2.0
      </a>

      <a class="cw-whale-tab" href="about-whalewatch.html">
        About WhaleWatch 2.0
      </a>

      <a class="cw-whale-tab" href="whalewatch-products.html">
        WhaleWatch 2.0 Products
      </a>

      <a class="cw-whale-tab is-active"
         href="whalewatch-explorer.html"
         aria-current="page">
        WhaleWatch 2.0 Explorer
      </a>

    </nav>

  </div>

  <!-- PAGE HERO -->
  <section class="cw-whale-explorer-hero">

    <span class="cw-whale-explorer-eyebrow">
      {safe(hero.get('eyebrow'))}
    </span>

    <h1>{safe(hero.get('title'))}</h1>

    <p>{safe(hero.get('subtitle'))}</p>

  </section>

  <!-- INFORMATION AND INSTRUCTIONS -->
  <section class="cw-whale-explorer-instructions">

    <details class="cw-whale-explorer-accordion" open>

      <summary>
        <span>{safe(instructions.get('title'))}</span>
        <span class="cw-whale-explorer-accordion-icon"
              aria-hidden="true">+</span>
      </summary>

      <div class="cw-whale-explorer-accordion-body">

        <p>{safe(instructions.get('introduction'))}</p>

        <ol>
          {instruction_list}
        </ol>

      </div>

    </details>

  </section>

  <!-- INTERACTIVE EXPLORER -->
  <section class="cw-whale-explorer-section">

    <div class="cw-whale-explorer-heading">

      <span class="cw-whale-explorer-section-label">
        INTERACTIVE TOOL
      </span>

      <h2>{safe(explorer.get('title'))}</h2>

      <p>{safe(explorer.get('description'))}</p>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-whale-explorer-app-card">

      <iframe
        src="{safe(explorer.get('app_url'))}"
        title="WhaleWatch 2.0 Interactive Explorer"
        loading="lazy"
        allowfullscreen>
      </iframe>

    </div>

    <p class="cw-whale-explorer-fallback">
      {safe(explorer.get('fallback_text'))}
      <a href="{safe(explorer.get('app_url'))}"
         target="_blank"
         rel="noopener noreferrer">
        {safe(explorer.get('link_label'))}
      </a>.
    </p>

  </section>

  <!-- DISCLAIMER -->
  <section class="cw-whale-explorer-disclaimer">
    {md(disclaimer.get('text'))}
  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```
